faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi (AIIMS Delhi), a prestigious government institution in the medical field.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for which applications are invited is Technical Assistant. This role is crucial for supporting various technical operations within the institute.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Technical Assistant position in this AIIMS Delhi recruitment drive, offering a focused opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Technical Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for candidates to submit their applications for the Technical Assistant post is 20 August 2026. Applicants should ensure their applications reach before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply for the Technical Assistant position via Email. This method simplifies the application process, allowing for digital submission of documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelors in Science degree to be eligible for the Technical Assistant position. Desirable experience includes research project involvement and animal handling.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the Technical Assistant post at AIIMS Delhi?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants for the Technical Assistant post is 50 years. There is no minimum age specified, focusing on experienced professionals.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Technical Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected Technical Assistant will receive a salary of Rs 27000 per month, along with an additional 30% HRA (House Rent Allowance), making it a competitive package.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for the AIIMS Delhi Technical Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category, including General/OBC and SC/ST candidates, making it accessible for all eligible applicants.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Technical Assistant position at AIIMS Delhi primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be assessed based on their qualifications and relevant experience.
